However, none of the declared technologies are honored: there is no FastAPI service, no SQL/PostgreSQL persistence, and no REST/HTTPS calls to external providers — everything is synchronous in-process Python objects, and the 'external' screening/notification/storage failures are driven by ad-hoc string flags smuggled into the same request dict the shipper submits, which is an invented integration mechanism with no spec grounding.
